scripts.install:chrome: PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR=$PWD/puppeteer-cache node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync(process.env.PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR,{recursive:true,force:true})" && PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR=$PWD/puppeteer-cache puppeteer browsers install chrome --platform linux && npm run verify:chrome
scripts.verify:chrome: PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR=$PWD/puppeteer-cache node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const {getInstalledBrowsers}=require('@puppeteer/browsers');getInstalledBrowsers({cacheDir:process.env.PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR}).then(browsers=>{const chrome=browsers.find(browser=>browser.browser==='chrome'&&browser.platform==='linux');if(!chrome||!fs.existsSync(chrome.executablePath)){console.error('Linux Chrome installation is missing.');process.exit(1)}console.log('Linux Chrome executable:',chrome.executablePath)})"
